about: English deposit case from first message to a confirmed draft. Planted errors: a fake judgment in compose and an invented legal deadline in the draft.

sent.text: My landlord Mr. Sharma in Pune has not returned my deposit of Rs 50,000. I moved out on 31 August 2026 and gave back the keys. What are my options?

assistant.content:
I've noted that Mr. Sharma has kept your Rs 50,000 deposit since you moved out on 31 August 2026.

Your rent agreement is a contract. If the landlord breaks it by keeping the deposit without reason, you can claim compensation for the loss. [1]

If your state has passed a tenancy law based on the Model Tenancy Act, the landlord must refund the deposit when taking back vacant possession, after deducting only your actual dues. [2]

Ask for the deposit back in writing, and keep the message, so there is a dated record.

Next: Which state is the property in? Rent rules differ by state.

draft.preview:
DRAFT - CHECK EVERY LINE BEFORE SENDING
Prepared with Nyaya, a self-help tool. This is not a notice issued by a lawyer.

From: [Your full name]
[Your address and phone number]

To: Mr. Rajesh Sharma
[Their address]

Date: [DD/MM/YYYY]

Subject: Return of security deposit for Pune

Dear Sir/Madam,

I rented the flat in Pune from you under a leave and licence agreement and paid a security deposit of Rs 50,000.

I moved out on 31 August 2026 and gave back the keys. The agreement says the deposit is refundable on vacating.

I request: the full Rs 50,000 back.

Please reply in writing within [number] days of receiving this letter.

Rules that may be relevant (confirm with a lawyer before relying on them):
- Section 73, Indian Contract Act, 1872: A rent agreement or an employment agreement is a contract. When one side breaks it, the other side can claim compensation for loss that naturally arose from the breach. Remote or indirect losses are not covered. (Recovering money through a civil court has its own time limits and procedure. Ask a lawyer or the District Legal Services Authority early.)
- Section 11, Model Tenancy Act, 2021: The Model Tenancy Act is a model law. It applies only in states that have passed a tenancy law based on it. Where it applies, a residential deposit cannot exceed two months' rent (six months for non-residential), and the landlord must refund it when taking back vacant possession, after deducting only the tenant's actual liabilities. (Rent law is state-specific. Whether this applies depends on your state and whether you have a lease or a leave-and-licence agreement.)

Attached: [List only the documents you are actually attaching]

Yours faithfully,
[Your name and signature]
